test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
There are 917 students in a college out of whom 535 are boys.

In the diagram, the triangle represents 134 students studying in English medium and the circle represents 279 students in science stream. Girls are represented by the rectangle. Partial information regarding the break up of the students and their choice of medium and stream is included in the diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae3f54c8c86696823a2cbf78712767117cb6ac409bee2a75160970dfcd3d2fed.png] 

Calculate how many boys are studying in science stream in the English medium.
solution:
The region that best represents the number of boys who are studying in science stream and in the English medium is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa2d5781c5979955419b5b0d731ed55a9545823ae7e8ca7bacc6e0235419659f.png] 

Here, the marked area shows the number of boys who are studying in science stream and in the English medium.

According to the question:

Total students in a college = 917

Total Boys in a college = 535

Total Girls in a college = (917 - 535) = 382
